snippet.title: The Roach Hotel - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
PLAY GAME NOW: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4075080/The_Roach_Hotel/

Chapter One: Skin Deep
Short Description: The Roach Hotel is a first person analog horror game that drags you into its halls, where every shadow hides a question and every corner dares you to keep following its path.
